title: What you need before playing
text: Reign is a Windows PC single-player mod with a local companion server. You need a licensed Bannerlord installation compatible with your Reign package, its required native modules and installed dependencies, and the launcher's dedicated ReignServer WSL environment. Use a current supported 64-bit Windows installation with WSL 2 and virtualization available. Check the package's supported game version before updating Bannerlord; this guide is not a promise of compatibility with every future release or other mod. A cloud LLM provider is required for Reign's AI dialogue and generated character responses. Configure a supported provider/account and its credentials in the Control Center, with internet access and sufficient provider allowance or credit. The local Reign server manages the game connection, data, memory, and requests; it is not a replacement for the cloud language model. Some background rules run locally, but that does not make the full AI experience offline. A cloud image provider is also required if you enable optional AI-generated portraits or scene images. It is configured separately from dialogue. Working chat does not prove image generation is configured. Existing bundled or cached images can display without generating a new one; new image requests need the selected image route to be available. You can play with optional image generation disabled. Provider charges and subscription limits belong to the selected service. More conversations, longer exchanges, events, and new images can use more allowance. Never put an API key into NPC chat; save credentials only in the provider settings intended for them. Diagram — Your PC runs Bannerlord, the Reign server, and memory services; dialogue and optional new images use separately configured cloud providers.

title: RAM: plan for the game and the server together
text: Reign does not have a verified RAM minimum or typical-use range yet. Use the published base-game requirements below as base-game figures, leave room for the local Reign services, and assess memory pressure during your actual session. A single development session's allocated memory cannot establish a hardware requirement. Component What we can currently say Base Bannerlord, published requirement The Steam listing gives 6 GB minimum and 8 GB recommended for the base game. These are system requirements, not measured process usage. Reign alongside the game The local server, database and memory worker need additional resources. Their ordinary and peak usage has not been measured well enough to publish a reliable extra-RAM figure. Your actual session Campaign age, battle size, settings, other mods and background applications affect memory use. Judge the complete session, including Reign's local services, rather than one process in isolation. We will add a typical-use range only after representative measurements during ordinary play, loading, saving and battles. Until then, the base game's figures are identified as base-game figures, and there is no separately certified Reign RAM requirement in this guide. If you check Task Manager, remember that committed memory is not the same as RAM currently resident in use. Do not count the Windows WSL process and Linux's own memory as two separate copies. If play stutters, inspect actual memory pressure and paging as well as CPU and graphics load.

title: Processor, graphics, storage, and connection
text: Requirement Practical guidance CPU Start with hardware that comfortably runs your intended Bannerlord battles. The published recommended base-game CPUs are Core i5-9600K or Ryzen 5 3600X. Reign adds local simulation and services; no separate Reign minimum CPU has been benchmark-certified. GPU and VRAM Meet the game/DLC requirements for your chosen settings. The base-game listing recommends GTX 1060 3 GB or Radeon RX 580. Cloud AI generation does not require you to load a large language or image model onto your own GPU, but the game and native portrait rendering still use it. Game storage Steam lists 60 GB available for base Bannerlord. DLC and other mods can add to this. Reign storage Keep additional SSD space for the module, shipped portraits, dedicated server environment, database, generated images, saves, backups, and updates. Their size grows with use; a fixed small download size is not the full installed budget. Update and backup headroom Keep several tens of gigabytes free beyond the installed game as a planning allowance, then monitor actual growth. This is headroom advice, not a measured Reign install-size requirement. A full drive can interrupt saving, database work, or updates. Internet Required while cloud dialogue or new cloud images are requested. Cloud latency, service outages, and provider limits affect response time even on a fast PC. Local services Keep the launcher-managed server, database, and memory worker healthy. WSL must have enough memory available; giving all system RAM to the game leaves no room for Reign's services. Base-game figures were checked against the official Steam system requirements on November 6, 2026. They do not include Reign or replace the requirements of any DLC you use. Reign-specific RAM measurements remain a follow-up; no new hardware requirement is inferred from a single development snapshot.

title: How to use this guide
text: New to Reign? Read Your first session , then Your first conversation . After that, follow whatever interests you: ordinary adventuring, relationships, running a household, or ruling a kingdom. You do not need a crown to enjoy most social features. Use the contents to browse, the A–Z index to find a topic, or search in your own words: wife , have a baby , NPC won't leave , troops expensive , letters , save warning , or become senator . Search includes the whole manual, not just headings. Clear search to return to your place. Your browser's Find command also works. This guide describes effects rather than balance formulas. Where the game asks you to choose an amount, duration, price, or setting, read the current terms on screen. An example sentence is a suggestion for what to ask, never a guaranteed answer or a cheat code. Pictures marked In-game screenshot are actual captures supplied by a player. Click a picture to open it at full size. Pictures marked Layout example are temporary Reign design references with illustrative people, text, and values. Pictures marked Diagram explain a process. Text instructions describe current source behavior where an older reference differs. Edition note: This is a guide to the reviewed development checkout, including implemented previews. A Preview notice means native or final release acceptance remains open, or the installed edition may differ. It does not mean every part is broken. See What is still being verified for the main areas. This guide itself does not certify the mod's gameplay.

title: What Reign changes
text: Reign adds a remembered social and political world to Bannerlord. NPCs have personalities, interests, relationships, private concerns, and different knowledge. Conversations can lead to genuine agreements and game actions. Letters travel, stories continue, families develop, councils deliberate, and rulers face consequences. It also changes things outside chat: the calendar is longer, exact NPC relationship scores are hidden, recruitment draws on village population, advanced troops are more expensive, raids leave lasting damage, garrisons and field armies have different burdens, and important world events reach you as news. Arena Overhaul is bundled into the Reign module. You still play Bannerlord. A description of a gift does not create an item, a boast does not win a battle, and council advice does not automatically issue an order. Real effects depend on the actual people, resources, authority, and game situation.

title: Your first session
text: Use the installed Reign launcher and its managed server controls. Start the local server and open the Control Center. Check its health before loading a campaign. In the Bannerlord launcher, enable ReignBeta and the required installed dependencies: Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx, and Mod Configuration Menu, alongside the required native modules. Use the dependency ordering shown by your installed package. Arena Overhaul belongs to Reign's module; avoid enabling a second standalone copy alongside it. In the Control Center, confirm your selected dialogue provider is configured. Configure image generation separately if you want it. A local server does not by itself make cloud AI requests free or offline. Load your campaign. Let Reign finish its preparation screen. If a stage fails, use Retry ; the preparation records completed work. Approach an available adult NPC and have a short conversation. Press backslash (\) or use MCM → Utilities → Open Party Chat if you want a group conversation. Ctrl+M opens Correspondence from a suitable campaign-map screen. Save with the server running. Pay attention to any Save Sync warning. Keep a matching campaign backup and native save before major changes. The current launcher-facing local address is http://127.0.0.1:8089 . Keep the URL selected by your installation; older instructions referring to a standalone Windows server or a different port may be out of date. The server now runs in its dedicated ReignServer WSL environment, managed by the launcher. Ordinary players do not need to run development commands. The preparation process connects the native save with Reign's matching history, prepares characters and households, and restores ongoing systems. New campaigns have an opening grace period before the autonomous world becomes busy. An initially quiet world does not mean the mod has failed.

title: The controls worth knowing first
text: You want to… Start here Talk to one person Their Reign conversation/Approach option Talk to your group Party Chat; backslash (\) Write or read letters Correspondence; Ctrl+M Build an explicit conversation action Alt+A in a supported, ready Reign conversation Send a ready chat message or letter Enter or Numpad Enter in individual chat, Party Chat, or Correspondence Advance or accept a ready builder step Enter inside the action builder Cancel the action builder Escape ; this returns to the conversation Find settings inside Bannerlord Mod Configuration Menu, usually called MCM Change AI providers or back up Reign data The launcher-opened Control Center Meet known local residents Visit the homes in a settlement menu Explore a household Explore the keep → Castle Layout Rule your realm Designate a capital, then Enter Rule Mode Review illustrated memories Memory Book in the quest interface These are the bindings in the reviewed source; the guide does not assume that an in-game rebinding control exists. If a key conflicts with another mod or your keyboard layout, the MCM Party Chat and Correspondence utility buttons provide alternatives. For Reign popups, Enter or Numpad Enter accepts an enabled affirmative choice and Escape normally cancels or acknowledges. Read the choice before pressing it, especially for arrests, payments, and lethal decisions. A key can operate the current popup rather than the screen underneath it.

title: Approach, speak, and listen
text: Open an eligible person's Reign conversation. With NPC Lives enabled, Approach can begin with what they are doing and how receptive they are. Speak naturally and be specific. “Could you tell me about your work?” is a useful first question. You can ask about their interests, recent events they might know, your relationship, or a practical request. Use Enter or Numpad Enter to send a ready message. Alt+A opens the action builder when this conversation has an eligible participant and is not busy. Escape first backs out of a supported open image or outfit layer, or closes the conversation when no protected decision is in the way. A pregnancy choice has its own controls; do not assume Escape answers it. NPCs can refuse, negotiate, misunderstand, conceal something, or ask for clarification. Their rank, duties, personality, relationship with you, and the people present matter. An adult civilian and a reigning monarch do not have the same authority. Reopening a recent conversation can restore it silently instead of producing another greeting. An unfinished reply may still be running; reopening is not a reason to send the same request again. If you see a clear failure with a retry control, use that control and inspect the result. In-game screenshot — Individual Chat with Istiona the Thorn: portraits identify the speakers, the transcript shows their exchange, and the writing area and Send control are below. Look for the writing area, the person you are addressing, and any action or pending-agreement controls. The current screen also has Look at them and View features described under Pictures and appearance.

title: Asking for a real action
text: For an explicit mechanical request, press Alt+A in a supported, ready Reign conversation to open the action selector. Its builder starts with I would like you… for the other person to act or I wish to… for your own offer. Choose the person, action, target, and requested terms. Review the resulting sentence before sending it with your speech. Inside the builder, Enter advances a text-entry step or accepts the completed action when its accept control is ready. Escape cancels the builder and returns to chat. Inserting the sentence does not send it: use the chat's Send button, Enter , or Numpad Enter after reviewing the full message. Alt+A is unavailable while the conversation is busy or has no eligible action participant. The available choices depend on the person and situation. You may see Give… , Go to… , Support… , Government decisions… , Court and intelligence… , Party and military orders… , Diplomacy… , Clan and kingdom… , or Personal requests… . Search inside the builder if you know what you want. The attached action sentence is kept as one meaningful unit. Editing the surrounding speech is different from changing the action's terms. If you change the agreement, review the new version and obtain fresh acceptance. A counteroffer is a new set of terms, not acceptance of the earlier offer. In the focused message editor, Ctrl+A selects all, Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+X cuts, and Ctrl+V pastes. Backspace/Delete remove selected text; their Ctrl variants delete by word. An attached action keeps its protected boundaries. Copying ordinary sentence text does not supply fresh agreement—use Alt+A to build the actual action again where needed. Try this: offer a small, affordable gift to a willing person using I wish to… → Give… . Name the actual item or gold amount. Check your inventory or money afterward. This teaches the difference between discussing a gift and completing one. Diagram — A real agreement passes from a clear proposal to acceptance, game checks, and an observed result.

title: Agreement is the beginning, not the result
text: After a request, distinguish three things: what you asked, what the NPC accepted, and what actually happened. A journey can be accepted but still take time. A transfer can be blocked by ownership, missing funds, distance, captivity, a changed target, or another active duty. An unsupported request cannot become real merely because the reply sounds enthusiastic. Check the action status and the native result: did the gold move, did the item change hands, did the party leave, did the treaty appear? A failure message is useful information. Correct the stated problem before trying again; repeatedly asking does not grant authority or multiply resources. Ordinary roleplay can still matter to relationships and memories. Treating someone kindly, insulting them, making a serious promise, or betraying trust can have social consequences even when no inventory transfer occurs.

title: Terms, conditions, and ongoing agreements
text: The action builder ( Alt+A ) can describe supported future timing, conditions, repeated payments, and exchanges with more than one term. Read who acts first, what triggers the next step, and what is still owed. “Give me this now and I will pay later” is different from an immediate exchange. Only the agreed revision binds the participants. Countering an amount, recipient, location, or date needs fresh acceptance. A pending, waiting, failed, cancelled, or recovery-required agreement is not completed work. Use its supported revise or cancel route and inspect any terms already fulfilled; cancellation does not imply that history or a real transfer is undone. Do not assume every conceivable condition is supported. The builder's actual choices and validation determine what the installed edition can do.

title: What you can ask people to do
text: Supported action families include giving or trading gold, possessions, equipped gear, troops, prisoners, workshops, land, and ships where applicable; following, guiding, traveling, waiting, and patrolling; party and army orders; mercenary service, clan or kingdom membership; court and intelligence work; diplomacy; political support; meetings; and personal experiences. Each has its own restrictions. Someone cannot give away another person's workshop, command an army they do not lead, or promise a government's vote on everyone else's behalf. A ruler's request and a peer's request are different. Ask the actual decision-maker and keep the purpose and terms clear. If a guide agrees to Show the way , follow them in the scene. Their agreement does not teleport you to the destination. If you leave them behind, the task can remain waiting or require recovery. Open the Action sentence system chapter for the full action list, timing, and when each choice appears.

title: Build and send an action sentence
text: Open a supported Reign conversation with an eligible adult and press Alt+A once it is ready. Individual Chat, Party Chat, Correspondence, social events, the tavern house, supported court audiences, Royal Council, and a selected War Council messenger can host the builder. Select the actual participant. In Correspondence, Ctrl+M opens the inbox from the campaign map. Choose I would like you… to ask the other person to act, or I wish to… to offer or declare an action of your own. Choose the action, then fill in the people, destination, quantity, or other terms. Use the builder's search for a named action or target. Review the sentence. Use Back to change a choice. Enter advances an entry or accepts a ready draft, and Escape closes the builder. Accept inserts the protected sentence in your message. Review any ordinary speech around it and then use the host's Send control. In Individual Chat, Party Chat, and Correspondence, Enter or Numpad Enter also sends a ready message. Read the answer and check the outcome. An offer may be refused or countered. A counteroffer changes the terms and needs fresh approval. Look for the actual transfer, arrival, report, or other effect. The lists below group actions by purpose. They include menu choices, offers that arrive through events, and follow-up controls. A choice can depend on the opening direction, eligible people and assets, current duties, location, authority, and feature settings. The chosen conversation may have further restrictions. Each row explains the situation and the choices or result. Some names in search may vary with the direction of the sentence. Use Review offer from… when an NPC has made an actionable offer. Inspect its exact terms before accepting or choosing Decline this offer . To counter, change the term in review and send the revised sentence. To stop a running order, use its cancellation route. The protected sentence is one attached action. Reopen it through Alt+A to edit the draft, or remove it as a unit. Plain copied text carries no attached terms. Once focus returns to chat, pressing Enter can send the message. If a choice is missing, check who acts, whom you addressed, whether they are free to act, and whether the feature and target are available. Some offers appear only when an event raises them. Try the exact action name in the builder's search.

title: Bargains and timing
text: A gift or request can end after one complete term. To negotiate an exchange, choose and I will give… or and you will give… in review. Add another action… combines compatible actions, and Edit a term or its timing… changes a selected term. A marriage proposal limits the consideration to the supported marriage assets. Where the term allows it, choose execution as soon as delivery and the bargain allow, after a number of days, on arrival at a settlement, on release of a prisoner, on ownership of a settlement, or on peace or war with a named realm. Installments repeat the displayed amount at the chosen interval. Read the total before agreeing. Payment can be made in advance or after verified fulfillment where the builder offers that choice. Remote terms can take time to deliver. Authority, stock, funds, and world state are checked before execution. Rebellion declarations and public pregnancy disclosures have their own immediate player declaration flow. For a negotiated action, check both consent and fulfillment.

title: Gifts and exchanges
text: Open Give… or use a give option in bargain review. The person supplying the term must own or lawfully control the selected asset. These actions can be gifts or pieces of a larger exchange. Action When and how to use it Give gold Choose the payer, recipient, and amount. The payer must be able to fund the transfer. Give an item Choose the owned item, exact variant or eligible equipment slot, and quantity where applicable. Give troops Choose the troop type and number from an eligible roster. Check the parties and their available troops. Give prisoners Select captives in the giver's lawful custody. This hands them to the recipient. Give land Select an eligible town or castle the giver can lawfully transfer. The transaction changes its ownership. Give a workshop Select a workshop owned by the giver. The recipient must qualify to take it over. Give a ship Select an eligible owned ship in a campaign that supports ships. Check transfer restrictions and location.

title: Personal and family actions
text: Use an eligible conversation with the people concerned. An NPC's personal offer can surface through its own interaction, with a review step for the agreed terms. Action When and how to use it Leave your spouse by letter Under I would like you… , ask a married adult NPC to send their current spouse a private separation notice. If agreed, it ends that marriage and can badly damage relations with the spouse's clan. The letter is the notice produced by the action. Expose their concealed pregnancy Use I wish to… as the only action in the draft when your character has the required verified knowledge. Choose the confirmed case and whether to name the known father. Share this personal experience Review an NPC's current personal-story offer when that event presents it. Acceptance applies to that specific offer. Take personal leave When the NPC offers personal leave, review their proposed departure and time away before agreeing. Summon a subordinate for a meeting Ask a qualifying clan leader or ruler to summon their subordinate. Select the person, place, reason, and stay. Review the quoted arrival and any army release. Change an agreed meeting In a conversation eligible to control the live meeting, select it and agree to the new place and duration. The arrival time is recalculated. Cancel an agreed meeting Choose the current meeting and agree to cancel. Reign releases the movement commitments made for that meeting. Join my party as a permanent companion Ask an eligible known resident. Agree the exact payment, if any, and check companion capacity. Soldiers need duty release first. Release resident from duty Ask the eligible commander or home-owning clan leader to release the named military resident before recruitment. Join my party as a temporary guest Agree in person with an eligible foreign noble or known resident. Set the purpose, fixed or open-ended stay, and any payment or army exit terms shown. Extend your stay in my party Ask a live guest who is still in your main party. Agree the revised term and relevant payment. Leave my party End the specific live guest agreement. The noble begins the return to their home party or other eligible destination. Accept the risks of fighting your own faction Ask a current guest under I would like you… when they face this risk. Fighting their own faction can replace them in their old role, banish them, and move them into your clan.

title: Marriage actions and wedding choices
text: Open the exact offer through View marriage offer or address the issuing clan leader through Alt+A . The dedicated wedding choices appear only with a relevant offer or ceremony. See Arranged marriage offers and cultural weddings for the delivery window, town visit, and settlement sequence. Action When and how to use it Propose an arranged marriage Choose an eligible leader, select your clan's prospect and theirs, and review the exact consideration before sending. Release a captive In marriage bargain review, select a captive held by the side providing that term. The person goes free when the marriage settles. Ask the prospective spouse to call off the wedding During the exact active ceremony, ask an eligible prospective spouse directly. The decision belongs to that person. Marriage alliance Use the marriage action with the exact eligible consenting couple. In personal conversation this binds the actual participants. Clan offers for relatives use the dedicated proposal route. For an incoming offer choose Accept this marriage proposal , Refuse this marriage proposal , or Request a meeting with… when offered. Select a safe town for the meeting and confirm the response to the issuing leader. Once the agreement is ready to book, the applicable choice is Marry now or Hold a ceremony . The ceremony also offers Withdraw from my wedding… for a participating player who chooses to end it.
aliases: Ask the prospective spouse to call off the wedding

title: Arrests and direct conflict
text: Address the accused for the arrest actions. Choose I wish to… to prepare an arrest, release a person, or rescind the case. A prepared arrest can lead to explicit confirmation, surrender, a duel, or a fight. See Arrests, confirmation, and custody . Action When and how to use it Duel me Ask the current NPC to duel. Select the available duel mode and play out the fight. Prepare arrest Use I wish to… with the accused present. Enter the accusation, category, and severity. Confirm through the next arrest step. Release arrested character As the player, select an applicable arrest case in custody. Release the person while leaving the accusation on record. Rescind arrest accusation As the player, select the case to withdraw. Custody ends if that case is what holds the person. Attack your party Use I wish to… after the accused refuses surrender in the prepared arrest. Select the case and eligible current party. Attack my party Ask a party leader to attack the player's party where the game permits the conflict. Surrender to me Ask the current NPC to surrender their eligible party. Resolve any subsequent custody or surrender step in the game. Leave me alone Ask the actor to stop pursuing or threatening your party. This affects the current behavior. Kill character Choose the living character targeted by the execution and review who will carry it out. The game excludes the player character and can block execution through campaign protections.

title: Following and guiding
text: These requests use the available scene or campaign context. A guide leads the way in the world and waits for observed arrival. Action When and how to use it Follow Ask an eligible actor to follow a person present in the scene or to follow the specified party on the campaign map. Stop following Ask the actor to end their current scene follow or campaign escort. Show the way Select a present person or recognized passage. Walk with the guide and allow them to register your arrival.

title: Party and military orders
text: Use Party and military orders… with the eligible commander, including via the War Council's messenger or a supported conversation. An order is supervised over campaign time. Check the chosen objective, targets, food, troops, army authority, and safe route. These orders command eligible NPC parties. Your main party can be an escort target, while you retain control of its movement. Identical objectives with alternate labels share a row. Attack settlement and Capture settlement plan have their own choices. Action When and how to use it Issue campaign order Build a supervised order with a single objective or combine stages. Set each stage's target and requirements, then confirm with the commander. Revise campaign order Choose the active order and agree the new objective, destination, area, or timing. The same order keeps its history. Cancel campaign order Choose the active order and agree to stop it. Its previous accomplishments remain recorded. Create party Ask an eligible lord without a party to establish one. Creation still depends on authority, local troops and funding. Go to Choose the town, castle, or village and have the commander travel there. Hold position Enter the campaign-map position to hold and confirm the coordinates before dispatch. Wait near settlement Pick the area and waiting time. The party waits under the order's safety rules. Patrol around settlement Choose a center and patrol duration. Use for a bounded local patrol. Scout report Select the settlement and time to scout. Read the report when the scout observes the area. Escort Choose the party to accompany and the duration. This can include the player's party as the target where eligible. Recruit and recover Set a troop goal and food goal where offered. Choose a supply location or let the commander find an eligible one. Form army Select the gathering area and intended strength where offered. The commander needs authority, influence, and eligible contributors. Join army Choose an active army the commander is eligible to join. Leave army Ask a commander currently serving in an army to detach with the required consent and authority. Disband army Ask an authorized commander to disband the army they lead. Raid village Select a hostile village and issue the raid order. Review the relationship and war consequences. Besiege settlement Choose a hostile town or castle. The force must be able to reach and prosecute the siege. Attack settlement Choose a hostile village to raid or a hostile fortification to besiege. The target type determines the order. Capture settlement plan Choose a hostile fortification and the relevant force goals. Use this for the capture plan and review its required stages and supplies. Defend Choose a settlement and how long the commander should defend it. Relieve siege Choose an eligible besieged settlement and send a suitable force to relieve it. Hunt enemy parties Set a bounded period to hunt eligible enemies in the applicable campaign area. Attack party Select the exact enemy party. The commander must have a party and authority to engage it. Withdraw Order the party to disengage or move toward an eligible withdrawal point. Return home Send the party back to its eligible home or a named destination where the order permits it.

title: Clan and kingdom actions
text: Start with the party who can perform the action. Clan changes, service and accords require the relevant authority, an eligible counterpart and the terms the game accepts. Action When and how to use it Hire me as a mercenary Ask an authorized ruler to hire your clan. Select the kingdom and review the terms of service. Release me from mercenary service Ask the responsible ruler to end your clan's current mercenary service. Accept my oath of vassalage Ask the eligible ruler to accept your clan as a vassal. Review the kingdom and any agreed terms. Release me from vassalage Ask the responsible ruler to release your clan from its current oath. Join clan Choose the eligible receiving clan whose leader is the counterpart. This moves the person selected to act into that clan. Leave clan Ask or offer to leave the actor's current clan when the native rules permit the change. Join kingdom Choose the joining clan and eligible ruler's kingdom. The action changes clan allegiance. Leave kingdom Choose the actor's clan when it can leave its kingdom under the current rules. Hire mercenary clan Arrange another clan's service with its leader and the hiring ruler. Select the clan and the hiring kingdom, then check the service terms. Create clan accord As a qualifying ruler, ask a willing noble to establish an available type of accord with their clan. Cancel clan accord Select the exact active accord and confirm ending it. Its benefits end. See Clan Accords for cancellation and relationship effects.

title: Rebellions and internal politics
text: Use the actual claimant, clan leader, ruler, or member involved. A pledge, an active rebellion and a completed political settlement are separate states. See Rebellion and civil war . Action When and how to use it Declare rebellion against your rule As clan leader, address your ruler and use I wish to… in a draft of its own. Select the realm and your claimant clan. Seek any pledges before declaring. Support me when I declare rebellion Seek an eligible clan leader's pledge before declaring. Name the challenged ruler. Their allegiance changes only if that rebellion begins. Recruit lord to rebellion Ask the addressed lord to commit their clan to your active rebellion. Join rebellion Use the player's side with the eligible NPC rebel leader to join their active movement. Surrender rebellion An eligible participant surrenders the named active conflict. Review the exact movement and the resulting state. Resolve civil war Use the rebel and parent rulers to agree a negotiated end to their active civil war with recognition of rebel independence. The surrender action handles capitulation. Consent government reduction Seek consent for the ruler's next reduction. A leader can speak for their clan. A clanless notable speaks for themself. See Government hearings and decisions for the separate reduction step. Install ruling clan Select the qualifying claimant clan after an internal challenge with the authority to install it. Support claimant Record support for the named claimant clan or pretender in the relevant kingdom. Encourage clan defection Name the clan and destination realm when the eligible parties can agree to its transfer. Exile clan Select the affected clan under the realm authority that can expel it. Restore exiled clan Select an eligible exiled or independent clan and the realm restoring it. Mediate clan dispute Identify the clans in the dispute. An agreed mediation becomes a recorded political obligation or outcome.
aliases: Support me when I declare rebellion

title: Realm diplomacy
text: Open Diplomacy… with the ruler who can act for the realm. Most bargains also require the other participating ruler. The authority rules for a declaration, treaty breach, promise, or support for an active rebellion depend on that particular action. Choose the actual realms and check the completed treaty, transfer, or decision. Some actions record a commitment to fulfill later. Action When and how to use it Declare war Select the foreign realm and give a reason. The acting ruler must have authority to declare war for their own realm. Back rebellion Use the sponsoring ruler and participating rebel leader in an active civil war. Name the movement and parent realm. The sponsor enters war with the parent. Make peace Use eligible opposing rulers to end their existing war on ordinary peace terms. Offer tribute peace Set the daily tribute and duration for peace. Check which realm pays before sending. Record promise The acting ruler records a promise, the other realm, and the reason for future memory and obligations. Demand reparations peace Set the gold or tribute the other realm would pay for peace. Demand settlement peace Select the enemy towns or castles to be surrendered for peace. Demand surrender peace Review the capitulation package with holdings, reparations or tribute. A defeated realm can lose its remaining land. Sign trade agreement Set the trading parties and duration. Check the native agreement and Reign's treaty record after acceptance. Sign non-aggression pact Agree a duration of restraint from attacks, raids, and hostile support. Sign alliance Use the participating rulers and set the alliance term. Check that the game records the alliance. Sign defensive pact Set a term of defensive support between the named realms. Break treaty Use the acting ruler, name the other kingdom, and review the treaty breach and affected native ties. Exchange prisoners Choose opposing realms with eligible noble captives. Both sides release captives under the agreed terms. Ransom package Agree the gold paid by one kingdom for its nobles held by the other. Hostage guarantee Record an eligible diplomatic security obligation. Check the exact terms before treating anyone as transferred. War indemnity Set the gold one kingdom pays the other for the war obligation. Recognize conquest Have the eligible realm formally recognize another's conquest or claim. Return occupied settlement Select the occupied town or castle the acting realm currently holds and can return. Demilitarized border Set the term for border restraint against raids or sieges. Caravan protection agreement Set a period for the two kingdoms to protect each other's caravans. Supply agreement Name the eligible resource or support, amount, and recipient realm. Check the recorded obligation and later delivery. Loan or subsidy Agree the amount, payer, and receiving realm. Check whether the terms record a debt or a subsidy. Pay to stay neutral Specify the payment and period for the recipient realm to stay out of the dispute. Pay to join war Name the third realm and compensation. The receiving ruler must be able to enter that war. Guarantee independence Set the term of an eligible pledge to defend another realm's independence. Protectorate or vassalage Record the participating kingdoms' protectorate or dependency terms. Diplomatic package Combine compatible sovereign terms such as gold, captives, settlements, and peace. Review the exact package and available assets.

title: Government support and petitions
text: Use Support… with an eligible filer, member, sponsor, or other person who can supply the particular commitment. The controls resolve a real government, current party, petition revision, proposal or election. Supporting one step gives the commitment for that step. Action When and how to use it Join political party Choose an eligible party for the actor's political membership. Back a party platform Choose the party and period of support for its platform. Support a proposal Choose the active government matter and the exact vote option the member should support. Support a party nomination Choose the nomination petition and party route. The builder binds the current revision and party selection. Endorse a petition Ask the eligible person to endorse the current petition. The exact revision matters. Sponsor a petition Choose the current petition draft and seek the eligible sponsor's support for that revision. Seek party adoption of a petition Choose the petition and obtain adoption through the applicable party route before presentation. Present an adopted petition Use the eligible presenter to submit the adopted petition to the appropriate government. Consent to transfer a civic mandate Choose the eligible mandate petition and secure the exact participant's consent. Nominate a party speaker Select an eligible party candidate in the current speaker election. Vote for a party speaker Choose the eligible candidate in the current speaker ballot. A petition selector can offer Prepare a new petition… . Choose the realm and proposal, then use Save and submit for sponsorship . Follow the petition's later endorsement, adoption, or presentation steps where required.
aliases: Seek party adoption of a petition
Consent to transfer a civic mandate

title: Government hearings and decisions
text: Open Government decisions… with the person authorized for the exact hearing, decision, or contribution. A recommendation and a vote have separate effects. See Government and political participation . Action When and how to use it Recommend an outcome The ruler selects a hearing and recommends a specific option. Members still cast their ballots. Introduce a government proposal Choose the government and an available policy, fief review, or clan-expulsion proposal. It enters the hearing process. Supply a government resolution Choose the active resolution and quantity of eligible goods from the acting character's travelling party inventory. Sponsor a petition Select the pending government business entry. This is the docket sponsorship route. The separate Support menu uses the petition draft and its current revision. Postpone a hearing Choose an eligible hearing with its permitted recess available. Reconvene a hearing Choose the postponed hearing when it can reopen. Call a government vote Choose the hearing when the responsible official can call its actual member vote. Decide a government hearing Choose the recorded option after the vote and applicable reconsideration period. Explicitly review an override if permitted. Grant more governing authority Select the eligible kingdom and approve an increase in its government's authority. Reduce governing authority Select the eligible kingdom and the reduction route. A forced reduction is a separate explicit choice where allowed. Fulfill a government resolution Select an active resolution and an available route. Any agreed reward waits for recorded fulfillment. Decline a government resolution Choose the pending resolution and decline under the current decision rules.

title: Court offices and ambassadors
text: Use Court and intelligence… with the consenting NPC and the relevant royal authority. Appointments depend on the office, the person's availability, current duties and court access. Action When and how to use it Serve as a court officer Select Steward, Economic Advisor, Foreign Advisor, Marshal or Spymaster for an eligible person. Leave your court office Ask the current officer to end their appointment. An active Spymaster can have outstanding work that blocks departure. Serve as ambassador Choose another active kingdom and either public information or improving relations. The posting is fulfilled on arrival. Return from your ambassador posting Ask the current envoy to return from an active posting. Change your ambassador mission Choose public information or improving relations for the envoy's current posting. Serve as Chancellor Agree the active-day salary with an eligible NPC. A new appointment begins inactive. Relinquish the Chancellorship Ask your current Chancellor to end the existing appointment through its court procedure. Change your Chancellor duties Ask your current Chancellor to take active or inactive duties from the next day, subject to salary and court conditions. Emergency and handoff coverage have their own rules. Serve as regent Legacy appointment entry. It uses royal court eligibility. For current court duties use the Chancellor route. Relinquish the regency Legacy departure entry that requires an active assignment. Current courts use Chancellor duties.

title: Spymaster missions
text: Use Court and intelligence… with your appointed Spymaster while the service has capacity. Choose the exact target and maximum operation cost. The ruler's available funds must cover the operation. Dispatch, detection, and success are recorded separately. Payment promised for success waits for the recorded result. A rumor is a reported claim. A reputation is an established label. Select the record you want to address. Action When and how to use it Gather settlement intelligence Choose an eligible settlement for an intelligence report. Conduct a counterintelligence sweep Choose the settlement to check for covert interference. Investigate a person's skills Choose the person whose abilities you want assessed. Investigate a person's relationships Choose the person whose social ties you want investigated. Investigate rumors about a person Choose the person and await the report on their rumors. Disrupt a settlement's food supply Select the eligible settlement to target with food disruption. Disrupt construction Select the settlement whose construction you want to impede. Disrupt security Select the settlement whose security you want to undermine. Disrupt loyalty Select the settlement whose loyalty you want to weaken. Attempt to assassinate a governor Select the settlement with the eligible governor. Review the cost and risks of a lethal operation. Attempt to assassinate a person Select an eligible living adult target. Review the cost and risks before dispatch. Mitigate a rumor about me Select the specific rumor about your character to counter. Mitigate my reputation Choose the specific reputation on your character's record to mitigate. Mitigate a rumor about a person Choose the person and the exact rumor to counter. Mitigate a person's reputation Choose the person and the exact reputation to mitigate. Promote a positive reputation Choose a person and enter the exact favorable statement to circulate. Circulate a harmful rumor Choose a person and enter the exact damaging claim to spread. Circulate a severe reputation Choose a person and enter the exact severe allegation to circulate.
aliases: Mitigate a rumor about a person

title: Follow-up controls and older action entries
text: The action system keeps separate entries for follow-up controls and older adapters. Follow-ups appear in their case or report flow. For the older transfer entries, the current conversation route is Give… . Action When and how to use it Confirm arrest Use the explicit follow-up after preparing a case. This step checks current custody and surrender eligibility. Respond to order report Use an urgent commander report to continue, adapt, hold, withdraw, or cancel the named order. Resolve rebellion pledge The secret preparation flow records a pledge, refusal, or report when the relevant decision occurs. Resolve rebellion summons The delivered summons flow records the player's response and the ruler's verdict. Older trade package Use Give… and add the other side's terms for a compound barter in conversation. Older gold transfer entries Use Give gold with the correct payer, recipient, and amount. Older item transfer entry Use Give an item with the exact item and quantity. Older workshop transfer entry Use Give a workshop for an eligible owned workshop. Older prisoner transfer entry Use Give prisoners for custody transfer, or the relevant release, exchange, or ransom action. The earlier Temporary Truce and Trade Embargo entries are retired. Use a supported non-aggression or trade agreement where it fits. Scene following uses Follow . Developer console and test commands have their own catalog and authority.

title: Personalities, interests, and private concerns
text: Characters have lasting personalities rather than a fresh personality each time you open chat. They can have hobbies, hopes, fears, values, attachments, a public manner, and private concerns. Compassion, honor, loyalty, responsibility, courage, judgment, and social boldness help shape their choices. Boldness in conversation does not necessarily mean courage in battle. Newer campaigns use richer authored backgrounds and stronger individual interests. Older campaigns retain their established profiles instead of silently replacing everyone's life story. Interests give you subjects to explore; they do not guarantee that every conversation will return to the same hobby or that an interest grants a mechanical skill. Personality can develop through meaningful experiences over time. Repeating the same compliment in one sitting is not a reliable way to rewrite someone's beliefs.

title: What NPCs know, believe, and keep secret
text: Reign separates actual world events from what each person has learned. A participant may know a battle immediately, while a distant court hears about it later. A private conversation is not automatically public. Someone may know your name or deeds without recognizing your face. An NPC can repeat a mistaken report or deliberately lie. You can ask who told them, challenge a claim, or provide evidence. Persuasive speech can affect belief without changing what really happened. Conflicting accounts are not automatically a continuity bug. Memory follows participants and context. People can recall shared conversation, commitments, important events, and experiences. They should not inherit the private contents of an unrelated person's conversation simply because they live in the same town. Diagram — An event, a witness's knowledge, a traveling report, and a rumor are separate things.

title: Relationships, visible status, and skills
text: Relationships are directional: you may like a person more than they like you. Time together, compatible personalities, conversation, shared obligations, and major actions can change that relationship. A lasting favor or betrayal can matter beyond one exchange. Reign hides exact NPC relationship scores throughout much of Bannerlord's interface. Read behavior, known history, and social clues rather than treating everyone as a visible score. Reveal All Character Relationships in MCM is an optional cheat. Skills remain visible in their normal mechanical interfaces. Clothing, equipment, holdings, reputation, and visible position affect how others perceive you. NPCs do not automatically know the exact amount in your purse. Dressing like a courtier and possessing a courtier's actual power are different things.

title: Added nobles and wanderers
text: Reign adds landless noble households to deepen local courts and expands the world of persistent characters. A landless court household is not automatically a field army; acquiring land can change its opportunities. Younger family members, local residents, and wandering adults serve different roles. Wanderers have individual identities and culture-appropriate backgrounds. Recruitment and companion limits still matter. Once someone is a persistent Reign character, their established identity and conversation history should not be treated as a disposable tavern extra. Eligible notables and encountered residents can use supported recruitment routes too. A recruited notable's former service and workshop dialogue need to follow their real current status; a former job does not grant you ownership of the town's business. Use an actual workshop-transfer agreement for a change of ownership. With War Sails , the Nord towns and castles have 13 additional tier-one court households and 78 authored nobles, with family ties, biographies, and shared portraits. Start a new campaign to meet these households. Their clans can gain rank normally. The content is installed and broader new-campaign acceptance is still open.

title: Party Chat and private audiences
chapter: Group chat, letters, and everyday communication
text: Press backslash (\) or use MCM → Utilities → Open Party Chat , select the people you want, then send your contribution to that audience. Enter or Numpad Enter sends a ready contribution. Alt+A opens the action builder for eligible selected participants. Escape closes an open image/portrait layer first or leaves Party Chat. All selects the available group and Clear clears selection. Eligible people depend on your party and safe location; availability is not permission to speak to someone across the world. Replies come from individuals, and later speakers can respond to earlier contributions. Each person speaks for themselves. Supported private or whisper conversations have a narrower audience than the whole group. Check the selected recipients before sharing something sensitive; merely being listed in a directory should not make someone a participant in a private Homes conversation. Changing a group can create a different conversation context. Where Continue is available, it resumes a retained group only when the original members and location are still eligible. A remembered transcript is not proof that an absent person has returned. Layout example — Party Chat: use the character roster to choose who participates, then read the shared exchange.

title: Travel banter
chapter: Group chat, letters, and everyday communication
text: Named adults actually traveling in your main party may talk among themselves in a small map window. Waiting in place does not start travel banter. Prisoners are not conversational party members for this feature. You can move the window by its title bar, resize it with the corner grip, and minimize it. Its dialogue control lets you join the selected speakers in Party Chat. Joining continues the exchange instead of asking the AI to invent a second opening. If the original speakers are unavailable, an old transcript may remain readable without becoming a live conversation. Window position and size are local interface preferences. They are separate from your campaign's memories and relationships. In-game screenshot — Party banter on the campaign map. Minimize is at the panel’s upper right; the speech-bubble control for joining is at its lower right. Here Niasen and Hularan are talking while accompanying the party. Scroll within the panel to read more of the exchange. The map happens to be paused in this picture; the banter window does not itself control campaign time.

title: Correspondence: sending and receiving letters
chapter: Group chat, letters, and everyday communication
text: Press Ctrl+M from a suitable campaign-map screen, or use MCM → Utilities → Open Correspondence . Choose a known living contact, read the thread, and write your message. Enter or Numpad Enter sends a ready letter; Escape closes the screen. Alt+A opens the action builder for an eligible selected correspondent when it is not busy. The shortcut may wait for a suitable screen; do not expect it to open over a battle, inventory, native conversation, save/load dialog, or another blocking interface. The list can also surface commanders who send order reports. A sent letter first travels, then arrives, then can be marked read. A reply has its own journey. Letters are faster in the revised system than in older editions, but they are not instant long-distance chat. Nearby letters arrive sooner than distant ones. Delivery-time and unsolicited-letter frequency adjustments live in the Control Center's Options. Changes affect future dispatches rather than rewriting a letter already in transit. Characters can write first, including an eligible introduction. You do not have to start every relationship by finding its owner in a keep. An introduction is delivered before the new correspondent becomes an ordinary contact. As your reputation grows, people from other houses may reach out and invite you to become acquainted. In the screenshot below, Leonilla mentions Michael’s tournament successes before welcoming a visit. Treat the invitation as an opening to meet or reply, rather than a guaranteed alliance or romance. In-game screenshot — Correspondence: Leonilla invites Michael to become acquainted after hearing of his tournament successes. Contacts and letter states are on the left; the letter and reply area are on the right. If a reply seems late, check whether the outgoing letter has arrived and allow campaign time to pass. Repeatedly sending the same question creates more correspondence, not a faster courier. An arranged marriage proposal can arrive as a signed letter. Open View marriage offer on the sender's thread to inspect or respond. See Arranged marriage offers and cultural weddings for the choices and deadline.

title: Promises to inform someone or send for them
chapter: Group chat, letters, and everyday communication
text: Preview: source-backed message commitments and summoned meetings have substantial implementation and partial native evidence, with further acceptance open. An NPC's clear promise to inform another named person can become a real message. While the conversation is still open, the promise can be corrected or withdrawn. Explicitly closing the conversation releases accepted outgoing commitments; a temporary screen handoff is not the same as finishing the talk. The recipient learns the delivered message, not everything you privately discussed. Asking an NPC to pass on an offer does not make the recipient accept it. A question needs a real answer and return delivery. A summons is an invitation that can be refused; acceptance still needs a safe location, travel, and an agreed stay. For a direct subordinate meeting, state the person, place, purpose, and length of stay. Keep the distinction between waiting for arrival and time spent together after arrival . A promised arrival is not evidence that the NPC is already present. Use Alt+A in the ready individual or group conversation to find the supported meeting action and review its terms.

title: Party announcements
chapter: Group chat, letters, and everyday communication
text: Preview: party announcements and later individual reactions are part of NPC Lives; broader acceptance remains open. Use Announce for a statement intended for your actual traveling party. It records what eligible party members heard without generating an immediate round of group replies. It does not address every person in the settlement, every member of your clan, or another party in your army. People who heard it may react individually when you later approach them. An announcement such as “We leave for the coast tomorrow” is remembered speech, not an order that moves the main party or creates an agreement. Use the action builder for a mechanical commitment. The action builder shortcut is Alt+A . Announce itself is the labeled screen control; it is different from the normal Enter send action.

title: Town events and tournament celebrations
text: When a social event is announced, visit the named town and use Attend the announced Bannerlord Reign social event . If you leave an active event, its Return option can reopen it while available. These are opportunities with closing windows; an announcement is not a permanent quest marker. Culture shapes the gathering. You may encounter feasts, fairs, dances, performances, contests, or outings. Events proceed through phases, giving different opportunities for introductions, group conversation, competition, or quieter exchanges. Tournament celebrations connect the local social scene with the winner and prize. Participation can develop relationships and award modest player skill experience. A real exchange matters; repeatedly opening a screen does not count as participation. See Participation XP for its settings. In-game screenshot - Courtyard Dance: Zotyra is Active while other guests are Available. The current phase is shown at the top; Wait Approach, Next Phase and End Event are on the right.

title: Wilderness encounters and personal matters
text: While traveling outside settlements, you may encounter a contextual scene involving eligible party heroes. Terrain, time, and companions affect its presentation. You can investigate, talk, apologize, challenge, avoid the issue, or end the exchange according to the situation. These scenes can also bring a developing rivalry, romance, shared secret, or obligation into the open. A private concern is different from a public court matter. Events do not need to occur during every journey, and the game avoids opening them over battles, sieges, or other unsafe interfaces. In-game screenshot - Wilderness roleplay: Morning Shade and Unfinished Weave shows Ulagara and Temurtai as active attendees, with the forest scene, encounter, narration and reply area beside them. Use End Event to leave.

title: Approach, invitations, and personal stories
text: Preview: NPC Lives has implemented stories and partial native tests. Meeting travel, leave/return, some mission outcomes, and final acceptance remain in progress. With NPC Lives enabled, people have activities and may be busy, relaxed, worried, or ready to ask for help. Companions and eligible guests actually accompanying you can invite you into personal experiences. Being in the same kingdom is not enough to receive every private invitation. Brief moments, outings, personal leave, independent activities, and longer story arcs have different purposes. Trust affects what someone is willing to share. Follow the stated objective, the agreed people, and any revealed Story Location in the relevant settlement. Meaningful conversation and actual activities move a story forward; repeating a password or praise does not guarantee progress. Some stories involve a practice duel, a hideout, an item, or travel. Those require the real game outcome. A story describing success cannot grant a victory, a reward, or a completed mission by itself. Lasting experiences, belongings, pets, and character development are intended to remain part of later conversation when actually established.

title: Personal leave and changing plans
text: An NPC asking for leave may have a private reason. You can discuss it, ask them to wait, or negotiate the arrangement. Repeating the same argument does not create unlimited persuasion credit. They can remain unwilling to disclose a concern or accept your request. Agree separately on any delay before departure and the time away after departure . Accepting time away does not permanently dismiss the character or recruit a replacement. Native return and duty restoration belong to the agreement's lifecycle, so inspect its status if the person seems overdue. Turning off new NPC Lives invitations stops new starts; existing commitments and safe recovery may still need to finish. It does not erase memories or make an accepted journey vanish.

title: Attention, jealousy, invitations, and rescues
text: People can notice you giving attention to others without overhearing the private contents. Neglected acquaintances may ask to talk; their temperament and what they actually witnessed affect the complaint. An approach is not proof of romance or wrongdoing. You may also receive invitations from local nobles, friendly patrol interceptions, or a chance to speak after a battle or prison rescue. These use the actual people and circumstances. Rescue conversation is separate from the native release or reward. Options → Player attention and NPC approaches has a master switch and separate preferences for attention, jealousy/neglect, keep invitations, patrol interceptions, and battle or prison rescue dialogue. Turning them off changes new approaches rather than undoing completed rescues.

title: People you meet can become persistent
chapter: Town life, residents, and tavern visits
text: Preview: persistent residents and Homes are implemented, with remaining native recruitment and reload acceptance work. Beginning an explicit Reign conversation with an eligible peaceful adult civilian, guard, or soldier can make that exact person a persistent character. Their encountered appearance and original work matter. Ordinary native shopping or asking directions does not need to turn every passerby into a new biography. The same person can be recognized later instead of being replaced with a generic extra. Their hometown and earlier life remain relevant after recruitment. A narrative family is not automatically a set of native Hero relatives; ask naturally rather than assuming empty native family links mean they have no household.

title: Visit the homes
chapter: Town life, residents, and tavern visits
text: Use Visit the homes in a town, castle, or village. The directory lists known residents who belong there and are currently available. Select a resident to enter the private home conversation. Directory neighbors are not automatically listeners. Visit in person takes you to the actual resident's scene and conversation, where available. It complements the private chat shortcut. If someone has left, changed duty, or joined you, recheck where they actually are rather than assuming their old card guarantees presence. To recruit a resident, ask for voluntary agreement and review any price, companion capacity, and duty-release conditions. A soldier leaving service needs lawful release and real manpower accounting. Permanent recruitment is different from inviting a temporary visitor. In-game screenshot - Homes directory: known residents at home appear as cards above the conversation area. Select a resident for home chat, or use Visit in person for the native settlement visit.

title: Visit the Madam
chapter: Town life, residents, and tavern visits
text: Preview: the town tavern venue is implemented and deployed in its recorded edition; full native acceptance remains open. In a town's tavern submenu, Visit the Madam opens a staffed venue with a madam, worker cards, conversation, and optional scenes. Adults have persistent identities; they are not newly invented for each visit. Discuss the people and payment with the madam, then review the exact participant and price confirmation. Only the confirmed participants join the private visit. Choosing a card or discussing a price is not payment. Campaign time stays paused until you leave the visit. Enter sends a ready contribution in this venue; Escape closes a portrait preview first or leaves the venue. Alt+A opens supported actions when the current conversation is ready. The scene-image switch is separate from portrait generation. Arrival and Look Again images illustrate the confirmed cast. Missing AI portraits can use native presentation; they are not permission for an automatic bulk image purchase. Repeated confirmed visits can produce Whoremonger gossip and a lasting reputation, with particular consequences for a spouse. A quiet period can let an active rumor subside; an established reputation is harder to lose. Staff can be recruited only through voluntary, supported agreement, and the venue replaces departed or retired workers with distinct people. In-game screenshot - Visit the Madam opening screen: the madam and worker cards are above the scene and conversation areas. No visit is agreed yet; scene images are OFF and a reply is pending in this example.

title: Clothing, drinking, and firm refusals
chapter: Town life, residents, and tavern visits
text: Characters can change outfits through a supported conversation request. A preview lets you compare the old and proposed appearance before keeping or reverting a change. Equipment, ownership, and eligible clothing still matter. Mounts and horse equipment are not wearable clothing props. Narrated drinking can build a persistent level of intoxication through an actual shared activity. A mention of a drink is different from a completed drink. Intoxication can affect how someone speaks and later recovers; it should not reset simply because you close the chat. NPCs can maintain firm refusals and negotiate for their own reasons. A prior gift does not purchase universal consent. A serious new reason or different terms can be relevant, but endless repetition is not a guaranteed way around a refusal.

title: Friendship, romance, and long memories
text: You can build affection through shared time, conversation, help, and compatible interests. Background relationship processing can also bring people closer or create friction. One person may feel more strongly than the other. Romance can progress from flirtation to a closer and more serious bond. Same-sex romance is supported. Rivalries, favor debts, marital conflict, and shared secrets can become ongoing stories rather than temporary mood changes. A life-changing act carries more weight than a routine compliment, especially when the benefit actually reached the recipient. Affairs and flings depend on the people involved and can lead to jealousy, rumors, pregnancy, estrangement, and public consequences. One willing person cannot supply the other's agreement. A marriage can deteriorate or end; its consequences can extend beyond the couple.

title: Marriage and NPC matchmaking
text: Native player courtship remains available. Use the arranged marriage flow to negotiate a named couple through their clan leaders. A match and its final marriage can happen at different times. With Use Reign-Controlled NPC Marriage enabled in Reign's MCM, background matchmaking favors clans of comparable standing. A lower-standing clan may need to pay compensation. Royal matches with landless houses require a rare opportunity as well as approval and funding. A completed match can improve both leaders' relations. A formal refusal can damage the proposer's view of the other leader, and identical refused terms are remembered. Changing the matchmaking setting preserves existing marriages. Leave your spouse by letter asks an eligible married NPC to end their existing marriage. The NPC must consent to the exact terms. Separation takes effect with a private notice and can badly damage relations with the former spouse's clan. A later marriage needs its own agreement.

title: Arranged marriage offers and cultural weddings
text: A clan leader can propose a match for you or an eligible member of your clan. To start a proposal, open Alt+A with the eligible clan leader and select Propose an arranged marriage… . Confirm both names, which clan a spouse would join, and the agreed gold, items, captive release or transfer, and eligible land. The exact accepted terms carry forward to settlement. Open Correspondence with Ctrl+M . Select the issuing leader, then choose View marriage offer . You can also use the action builder with that leader in an eligible conversation. Choose Accept this marriage proposal , Refuse this marriage proposal , or Request a meeting with… when available. You have 30 campaign days from delivery to respond. A timely sent acceptance or refusal stays on record while the courier travels. An unanswered offer can expire. Refusal and expiration have different relationship consequences. For a meeting, choose an eligible town and check the arrival estimate before sending the request. There is one timed visit for the offer. Speak privately with the prospective spouse to learn their answer. For an agreed player-clan match, select Marry now or Hold a ceremony when the choice becomes available. For a ceremony, choose from the towns the couple can safely enter. The booking gives you a date and attendance window. Other eligible NPC matches can schedule a wedding automatically. Attend the scheduled ceremony and complete its cultural stages. During the ceremony, an eligible player can open Alt+A and choose Withdraw from my wedding… . At finalization, check the spouses, clan move, and completed transfers. Guests return to their ordinary duties afterward. Installed. One Aserai playthrough in Bannerlord on a disposable save verified the courier, meeting, all three stages, settlement, guest release, and reload. Other cultures and interruption paths have more limited acceptance evidence. See Marriage actions and wedding choices for the exact builder routes.

title: Having a baby: the important change
text: A new player-parented pregnancy can begin only through a qualifying intimate event in an individual Reign conversation. Bannerlord's background spouse-visit pregnancy system is disabled for the player and their spouse. Simply marrying, waiting together, traveling with your spouse, or sharing a settlement will not create a new child parented by the player. This applies whether the player would be the mother or the father. A group conversation, a letter, or an announcement is not the individual-chat conception route. The relationship, adult eligibility, reproductive age, biological pairing, and family restrictions still apply. A qualifying scene creates an opportunity, not a guaranteed pregnancy. When the qualifying scene reaches its reproductive choice, read the actual inquiry. Proceed allows the conception opportunity to resolve. Pull Out prevents that opportunity and returns the choice to the conversation. Reopening or repeating a cancelled choice does not create another roll for the same event. Diagram — Player family route: eligible individual roleplay leads to a real choice; pregnancy is possible only after proceeding and valid game checks.

title: Pregnancy, parentage, and pregnant companions
text: Reign distinguishes biological and legal parentage. A pregnancy can be private, and revealed illegitimate parentage can bring social consequences. A child's recorded history is not just whatever someone last claimed in dialogue. The action selector can also expose a confirmed concealed illicit pregnancy when the required knowledge exists, with optional known paternity. That is a public disclosure with consequences, not a guess based on a rumor or an omniscient way to discover a secret. With Restrict Pregnant NPCs From Combat enabled, pregnant NPCs withdraw from field duties and cannot start normal combat or military orders. They seek a safe fortification; party command may transfer or the party may be handled safely. This setting excludes the player character. Birth restores ordinary eligibility, but it does not magically recreate an old party. Switching the setting off likewise does not reconstruct a party that was already disbanded. If your pregnant companion is unavailable for a patrol or duel, check this setting before treating it as a broken order.

title: Children and Family Chambers
text: Use Family Chambers from Royal Court or Explore the keep → Castle Layout to find eligible adults and children present in that household. Adult cards and child cards are connected: selecting a parent helps you find their children, and selecting a child helps identify available parents. Use Escape to return from the Family Chambers screen. It is a screen-navigation key, not a decision about the family. Children receive age-appropriate family conversation, not adult romance or military orders. They can remember childhood interaction, with very early memories treated differently as they grow up. Education and normal skill information remain visible in the appropriate native interfaces. In-game screenshot - Family Chambers before entering a scene: choose eligible household members from the noble and child lists, then use Enter Scene. Return to Court leaves this screen.

title: Gossip is not proof
text: Personal gossip is information moving between people. It can be delayed, private, mistaken, selectively repeated, or maliciously exaggerated. A speaker needs a reason to know something; the entire map does not instantly hear every private incident. Rumors are temporary public suspicions. Repeated or decisive evidence can establish a longer-lasting reputation. A correction can disprove an active rumor without instantly erasing what society already regards as settled. Neither a fabricated rumor nor a forceful accusation rewrites the actual event history. Preview: the expanded personal-gossip and delivered-message systems have continuing acceptance work. Their privacy and travel rules matter when interpreting what an NPC should know.

title: What your reputation changes
text: Public Standing reflects how active rumors and reputations shape your social position. It affects existing social connections rather than making every stranger a close acquaintance. Charm can soften negative reactions; it does not undo the underlying conduct. The same event can have personal and public consequences. A spouse's reaction to an affair is not the same as a distant courtier's. Favoring one courtier can create jealousy in others. Public judgment is also shaped by the setting's unequal social norms, including different treatment of some men and women.

title: Reputation names you may see
text: Area Common signals and what they mean Family and conduct Disloyal , Promiscuous , Marital Strife , Divorcee , Flirt , The Unchaste , Infertile , Dynasty Secure , Whoremonger concern relationships, family, and public conduct. A social accusation is not a medical diagnosis. Combat Strong/Weak Captain , Tactician/Failed Tactician , Siege Commander , Inept Besieger , Siege Breaker , Champion of the Pit , Duelist , Fallen Challenger , Coward , War Crowned , Defeated Crown , Battlemaster , The Frail reflect credited performance. Rule and welfare Realm Builder/Realm in Decline , Provider of the Realm/Starving Crown , Unifier/Fractured Crown , Keeper of Order/Lawless Crown , Guardian of Commons/Lord of Empty Fields concern the realm you govern. Distribution and command Consolidator/Overextended Crown , Fair Hand of Crown/Hoarder of Titles , Gatherer/Scatterer of Banners , Steward of the Realm/Ruinous Crown reflect patterns of leadership. Court Well Regarded , Court Favorite , Beloved of Court , Ill Regarded , Shunned at Court , Court Pariah , Favors [person] , Attentive Lord , Absent Lord concern public position, favoritism, and presence. Some broad titles summarize several underlying signals. Presence at court, neglect, wars, food security, village recovery, and actual outcomes can all contribute. You do not have to discuss your reputation in chat for the world to notice your rule.

title: Managing a damaged name
text: First identify whether the problem is a rumor, an established reputation, a personal relationship, or a real unresolved act. They need different remedies. Correct false information, fulfill promises, address the cause, or use a Spymaster's supported social mission. Removing gossip does not release a prisoner or repair a betrayed relationship by itself. A successful reputation mission may weaken a signal rather than erase it. Cancellation or a failed mission does not refund all spent resources. Read its result before commissioning another operation.

title: Castle Layout and room conversations
text: Choose Explore the keep → Castle Layout to see the household's rooms and available people. Room placement reflects time of day, roles, and current availability. A courtier may be in the library in one part of the day and dining later. Escape returns from Castle Layout to its origin. Room choices themselves use the displayed controls. Rooms include the gardens, noble solar, library, training yard, inner and stable courtyards, small dining chamber, portrait gallery, main hall, chapel, throne room, baths, guest bedrooms, royal bedroom, and battlements. Selecting a room opens its supported conversation context. The people shown are the people available for that session; a bedroom assignment does not itself establish an affair. Castles have the keep exploration and household routes as well as towns. Court authority, ordinary household access, and government access are separate permissions. You need not own a kingdom just to understand what a public room or household interface is showing. Layout example — Castle Layout: choose an occupied room to find its people instead of searching an entire native scene.

title: Training Yard
text: Use Visit the training yard from the supported keep menu. Select an eligible adult traveling with your party as trainer, review the troops and displayed training rate, then choose Train . The trainer's Leadership and weapon expertise affect the work. Training advances campaign time. It awards experience to eligible regular party troops; it does not directly upgrade them or provide free upgrade equipment. Troops already ready to upgrade cannot keep banking unlimited training through this screen. Use Stop when finished.
